thread:
nina: hi all, i accepted the org invite but i can't see the repos under the eng-platform team. When I try to clone serving-runtime I get a 404. anyone know why?
leah: welcome nina! :wave: 404 usually means you don't have permission or the repo is private. which clone URL are you using?
nina: using https: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime.git
leah: can you paste the exact error you see when cloning? also check if your github account email matches the one used for the invite.
nina: error:  
```
Cloning into 'serving-runtime'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: repository 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime.git/' not found
```
leah: ok -- that message can appear if your SSO isn't authorized or if you're not a member of the team that can access repo. try visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and click "Authorize". if that page redirects or errors, say so.
nina: i tried authorize but get "SSO: Authorization required" and there's no button. i accepted invite on my phone earlier, maybe that caused mismatch.
infra-bot: Note: org requires SSO authorization and team membership for private repos. See https://redwood.help/sso-ssh.
leah: i'm going to re-send the invite and add you to eng-platform. cc @invite-bot
invite-bot: Sent new org invite to nina@example.com at 2026-01-09T10:31:02Z
leah: after you accept, authorize SSO from the same desktop browser session, then try cloning. if you still get 404, run `gh auth status` and paste output here.
nina: accepted the new invite and authorized SSO in Chrome, `gh auth status` shows SSO: Authorized. clone succeeded. thanks!
leah: great — welcome aboard :tada: If you want push access to infra infra-repos, ping me or file a request in the access request doc.
